883-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
883-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

3899-4826-5222-6644.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

4247-6014-6659.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-3641.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-3641.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3147-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1558-2097-3147-3875-4231.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

725-1003-1329-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Walker, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Phyrexian Walker, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

4785-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4053-6797-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

5470-6188-6968.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5470-6188-6968.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2173-2459-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1110-5641-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
1110-5641-6919.notablePrerequisites: You control a static effect that boosts the power of creatures and/or creature tokens you control by at least 1.
1110-5641-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-5498-6811.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-5498-6811.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Reito Lantern twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

539-2438-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-3129-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2034-6263.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Myr Retriever spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-803-3742-4251-4885.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-3742-4251-4885.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-3490-4210-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4210-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3750-3755.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
3750-3755.description:
Activate at least five creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3169-4050-5751-5763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3169-4050-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Circle of the Land Druid trigger, allowing you to mill four cards.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Circle of the Land Druid and the Myr, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

293-4050-5220-5716.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Narcomoeba, adding one mana of any color.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

499-2034-3578.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificng Chronosavant, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Activate Chronosavant by paying {1}{W}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to skip your next turn.
Repeat.

104-2060-2325-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Soulmender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Soulmender.
104-2060-2325-3525.description:
Activate Soulmender by tapping it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Soulmender.
Repeat.

784-1430-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a Treasure token.
784-1430-3327-3719.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Mirror Image.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirror Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

2757-3000-5009.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control a basic land.
2757-3000-5009.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Ruthless Knave's second ability.

1789-2232-2972-3593.notablePrerequisites: You have a Dragon creature card in hand.
1789-2232-2972-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any Dragon from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, Ganax and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Ganax.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
